prompt: In a post-apocalyptic cityscape at dusk, a survivor is kneeling beside a crackling campfire. The survivor is holding a wrench and repairing a large, damaged humanoid robot lying on the ground. The campfire is between the survivor and a small, tattered tent, which is taller than the kneeling survivor. To the right of the tent, a loyal guard dog is standing, facing away from the group. The makeshift armored truck, parked behind the survivor, is much longer than the robot. A rifle, which is longer than the wrench the survivor is holding, is leaning against the truck's front wheel. Next to the robot is a pile of scrap metal, and next to the survivor lie two tools. The number of scrap metal pieces is three times the number of tools. The truck has a battering ram attached to its front bumper. The survivor is pointing the wrench at an open service panel on the robot's chest. The robot is missing one leg. The campfire is the brightest source of light. The survivor is pushing a new gear into the robot's exposed wiring. The robot has one of its arms reaching towards the survivor. The dog is looking into the darkness. The rifle has a scope mounted on it. The survivor is wearing a gas mask which is covering their face.
